title: 校验
summary: 「做个表单校验」只说了会报错。先定是失焦就说、这一栏立刻说，还是提交时一次说完。
summaryEn: “Add form validation” only says an error will appear. First decide whether it speaks on blur, in that column at once, or all at once on submit.
asksEn: When should the error be spoken?

links.when: 何时报错不是填还是选
links.whenEn: when to speak is not fill versus pick

links.when: 行内报错不是一条 toast
links.whenEn: an inline field error is not a toast

links.when: 提交一次标出不是 modal 确认
links.whenEn: marking every miss on submit is not a confirm modal

links.when: 何时开口不是三个时刻该交代什么
links.whenEn: when to speak is not what the three moments disclose
